Comprehension:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.Elara lived in a village nestled beside the Whispering Woods. Unlike the other children who chased butterflies and climbed trees, Elara was captivated by gears and springs. Her small room overflowed with dismantled toys and half-finished contraptions. One crisp autumn morning, a travelling tinker arrived, his cart laden with curious trinkets. Among them, a clockwork canary with gleaming brass feathers and tiny ruby eyes caught Elara’s attention.The tinker, a man with twinkling eyes and a long, grey beard, wound the key, and the canary burst into a surprisingly melodious song. Elara was mesmerised. She traded her most prized possession, a smooth, grey river stone she’d carried since she was little, for the mechanical bird. Back in her room, Elara didn't just listen to the canary sing. She gently probed its intricate workings, her nimble fingers tracing the delicate connections. Days turned into weeks, filled with the soft whirring of gears and Elara’s quiet concentration.One afternoon, the canary’s song faltered and then fell silent. Most would have been disheartened, but Elara’s eyes gleamed with newfound purpose. Now, the real puzzle began. She sketched diagrams late into the night, her candle flickering as shadows danced across the walls. Pages filled with possibilities, each scribble bringing her closer to understanding. With every twist of a screw and alignment of a gear, Elara wasn’t just repairing a bird—she was building her dream, one click at a time. Her world, once quiet and ordinary, now buzzed with invention, hope, and the promise of something greater.Which of the following options based on the passage has the most appropriate connection to real-life situations?
options: The satisfaction derived from understanding how things work and overcoming challenges
The potential dangers of interacting with strangers
The importance of saving money to buy desired items
The fleeting nature of material possessions
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (The satisfaction derived from understanding how things work and overcoming challenges) है।

Comprehension:Read the given passage and answer the questions that follow.Reading refines the mind, much as exercise strengthens the body. It adds depth to one’s understanding, shaping character through disciplined engagement with thought. Some books are to be tasted, others to be swallowed and a few to be digested fully. This means that not all reading requires the same intensity; some texts serve for amusement, others for knowledge and a rare few for shaping wisdom. The study of books should be balanced by conversation and experience. Reading alone makes a person contemplative but applying that knowledge to life demands interaction and practice. Different studies nurture different faculties. History makes men wise, poetry makes them imaginative, mathematics sharpens the intellect and logic teaches precision in argument. Yet reading without critical thinking can lead to pedantry. Bacon insists that learning must serve practical ends—moulding judgment, enhancing discourse and improving moral conduct.However, one should also beware of using knowledge merely to show off. Some people use learned words only to impress, but true wisdom lies in applying knowledge humbly. Study serves best when it supports action. In all, Bacon suggests that reading, like any tool, must be directed wisely—neither avoided nor worshipped, but put to proper use.What can be inferred from the passage?
options: Knowledge should be applied in life, not just admired.
Studying too much leads to bad morals.
All books should be memorised word for word.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'A' (Knowledge should be applied in life, not just admired.) है।

Comprehension:Read the passage carefully and answer the questions that follow. By mid-2025, the global water crisis is expected to reach unprecedented levels. According to the 2024 UN World Water Development Report, approximately 2.2 billion people lack access to safely managed drinking water, and 3.5 billion lack safely managed sanitation services. Meanwhile, nearly half of the world’s population experiences severe water scarcity for at least part of each year. Agriculture consumes about 70% of global freshwater withdrawals, while industry and municipal use account for roughly 20% and 12%, respectively. Climate change is further destabilizing the hydrological cycle. Rising temperatures, glacial melt, and changing precipitation patterns are reducing freshwater availability, while floods and droughts increase in frequency and severity. Coastal aquifers face growing salinization: studies show that by 2100, as much as 77% of coastal aquifers could be affected by saltwater intrusion due to sea-level rise and declining recharge. Water scarcity today already affects 40% of the global population, and demand is expected to surpass supply by 40% by 2030. Groundwater depletion continues, especially in densely populated regions like India, China, and Pakistan, where aquifer recharge lags behind extraction. Many megacities now face “Day Zero” scenarios, where municipal taps could run dry without drastic conservation and infrastructure reform. While innovative technologies—such as biodegradable hydrogels that extract water from the air—offer promise for remote or water-stressed regions, current investments fall significantly short of what's needed (a shortfall of $85 billion per year) to achieve universal access by 2030. Experts warn that without coordinated global investment, transparent governance, equitable distribution, and water-efficient infrastructure, the world risks escalating conflict, agricultural collapse, economic instability, and public health crises on a global scale.Which facts are stated in the passage? 
A. 2.2 billion people lack safe drinking water
B. 77 % of aquifers are currently polluted
C. Agriculture uses 70 % of global freshwater
D. Water demand to decline by 2030
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Both A and C) है।

‘वसंत ऋतु में कोयल की मधुर आवाज सुनाई देती है। मधुर आवाज सुनकर मन प्रसन्न हो जाता है।’- रेखांकित शब्द का पर्यायवाची है-

Comprehension:दिए गए गद्यांश के आधार पर निम्नलिखित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए।आज की अर्थ प्रधान व्यवसायिक दुनिया में साहित्य के मूल्यांकन के लिए लेखक, प्रकाशक और पाठक के व्यावसायिक  परिप्रेक्ष्य को उपेक्षित करना संभव नहीं है। सामाजिक सरोकारों के साथ आर्थिक सरोकारों की भी अपनी मुख्य भूमिका है, जिससे साहित्य का रूप निर्धारित होता है। साहित्य की रचना प्रक्रिया के जो तीन मुख्य पक्ष हैं - रचना, रचनाकार और पाठक, इनमें से किसी एक पक्ष को ही अब तक की आलोचना-पद्धतियाँ अपने विवेचन का केंद्र बनाती  रही हैं । साहित्य का समाजशास्त्र एक साथ इन तीनों का विवेचन विश्लेषण  करता है। उसका लक्ष्य लेखक और रचना, लेखक और पाठक तथा पाठक और रचना के अंतरसंबंधों की व्याख्या करना होता है। क्या कारण है कि ‘वर्दी वाला गुंडा’ की 20 लाख प्रतियाँ हाथों हाथ बिक गईं और शिव प्रसाद सिंह का ‘नीला चाँद’ या सुरेंद्र वर्मा का ‘मुझे चाँद चाहिए’ पुरस्कृत होने के बावजूद मात्र पुस्तकालयों की शोभा बढ़ा रहे हैं। यहाँ मूल्य की भूमिका भी प्रमुख नहीं है, क्योंकि यदि ऐसा होता तो बीस रूपये कीमत वाले सभी पेपरबैक संस्करण की मांग सस्ते और बाजारू उपन्यासों के बराबर हो जाती। अपनी समग्रतावादी  दृष्टि के कारण साहित्य का समाजशास्त्र इन सारे कारणों की जाँच पड़ताल करता है।साहित्य की रचना प्रक्रिया के कितने मुख्य पक्ष हैं ?
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (रचना, रचनाकार और पाठक) है।
